SELECT c.*, m.major_name FROM sys_course c LEFT JOIN sys_major m ON c.major_id = m.id WHERE 1=1
AND (c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.course_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
AND c.major_id = #{majorId} AND c.grade = #{grade} ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id
SELECT c.*, m.major_name FROM sys_course c LEFT JOIN sys_major m ON c.major_id = m.id JOIN teacher_course tc ON c.id = tc.course_id WHERE tc.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id
